Adds a company to the directory. Create `src/content/companies/<company>.md` with:

```markdown
---
name: Acme Corp
tagline: logistics software # a few words, shown on the card
url: https://acme.example
tags: [saas, logistics] # lowercase; reuse existing tags where you can
size: "11-50" # "1-10" | "11-50" | "51-200" | "200+"
# founded: 2014
# location: Armory Square
# blurb: "One sentence on what you build and who for."
# hiring: true
# careersUrl: https://acme.example/careers
added: 2026-09-25 # today's date
---
```

- [ ] The company builds software (or employs people who do) in Central New York
- [ ] `url` is the company's own site
